game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.116: monsters turn on everyone fighting them, in turn; the Spider Queen gives each adventurer her crown, once; card tables keep up at eight players and when someone leaves. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
